items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: No, I heard of him when I got in Chicago. To tell the truth, I saw him. But he left and went to England or somewhere while I was there.

ctx.x: He's above the staff. Yeah, he is above the staff. Did you know Tommy Lightnere down here?
No, I heard of him when I got in Chicago. To tell the truth, I saw him. But he left and went to England or somewhere while I was there.
And I never knew no more of him. Did you know Joe Alba down here? Down here?
